clue.text: Soufflé is ruined by a bit of lemon oil, perhaps

explanation.surface: A cook laments that a dessert collapsed because of a drop of lemon oil.
explanation.walkthrough: 'oil' looks like part of the kitchen scene, but 'oil, perhaps' is the definition by example.
explanation.definitionFit: Oil is one example of a fuel formed from ancient buried organisms, alongside coal and natural gas.

clue.text: Breathless note: "Bear pelt will cover debts"

explanation.surface: A rambling trivia question about Aretha's music, wryly insisting its oddities are deliberate.
explanation.definitionFit: Aretha Franklin, the Queen of Soul, was a leading voice of this gospel-rooted African American style.

clue.text: "Enter the thing" involves dreadful pun

clue.text: Anticipation of loud, playful sea otter

clue.text: Get hostages to adopt beliefs and customs

parts.note: the answer runs from the end of get into the start of hostages

clue.text: Small hack wound's effect

parts.note: in American usage a hack is a taxi, or cab

explanation.surface: A minor cut from a blade leaves a mark behind.

clue.text: Plants tragic ending at start of play

explanation.definitionFit: Cacti are spiny succulent desert species, so they are a kind of vegetation.

clue.text: Vampire can — endowed with anger — deliver a record of achievement

clue.text: It is good for you to compete after swallowing a mint, well-chewed

clue.text: Sports official interrupting rest, unfortunately — it's hard to know how to solve that

clue.text: For example, Mohawk's humble dwelling concealing air conditioner's front

clue.text: Grant entry to maid in distress, ahead of time

clue.text: Conductor's actions in medley

explanation.definitionFit: Arturo Toscanini was a celebrated Italian maestro who led the NBC Symphony Orchestra, so he is an example of a conductor.

clue.text: Got ri of

clue.text: Obscene shift to the right around Christian Era

explanation.definitionFit: Something indecent offends standards of propriety, especially sexual ones, much as obscene material does.

clue.text: Scotch pancake made from stewed scrod? Nope

clue.text: Recited opening of Whitman poem: "Put this on a cake"

parts.note: Walt Whitman's poem I Sing the Body Electric begins with these two words

explanation.definitionFit: The sweet sugary coating spread over a cake is its frosting, the thing you put on top.

clue.text: Bogus restriction excluding left

explanation.definitionFit: Imitation goods copy the real thing, so they are fake or counterfeit.

clue.text: Confronted government agent circumscribing type of power

clue.text: See 1
Arcane matters — i.e., a corset untied

clue.text: Walk rated "no good"

indicators.note: letters declared no good have to be fixed by arranging them differently

clue.text: Allowed within Somali city

clue.text: Take part with singer/actress in recital

parts.note: Cher is the American pop singer and Oscar-winning actress

clue.text: Burn contents of fiscal dossier

clue.text: Rear of DeSoto automobile encased by a little instrument

indicators.note: the rear of a word is its final letter

parts.note: something encased by another thing is in it
